_comment: Vendor sandbox / preview environments for USCDI Patient Access, loaded by `manage.py import_sandbox_ehrs`. Client ids are NOT here: each belongs to one deployment's app registration (its redirect URI is that deployment's), so pass them with --client-id "<vendor row>=<id>" or set them on the EHRs admin page. Sign-in settings (skip auth screen, extra scopes) come from EhrVendor.DEFAULTS_BY_NAME for Epic and Oracle Health rows; the other rows need none.

sandboxes.note: fhir.epic.com > Build Apps: the Non-Production Client ID. Test patients: https://fhir.epic.com/Documentation?docId=testpatients
code Console (code.cerner.com) app of type Patient, Public, SMART v1. Access tokens last about 9.5 minutes.
connect4.healow.com developer portal, Patient App (Public, OpenID). Practice code JAFJCD is the shared sandbox; test patient logins are in healow's FHIR documentation (Sandbox Testing Guidelines).
developer.api.athena.io: Certified APIs only, 3-Legged OAuth for Patients, Browser app type, PKCE, Preview environment.
developer.adp.ahcentral.com FHIR App (public client, Test Only). Patient test logins come from the portal Support Widget. Two brands share the one vendor row.
